ex.en: A security guard escorted us to the exit.
ex.zh: 一名警衛護送我們到出口。

ex.en: Please escort the visitors to the meeting room.
ex.zh: 請陪同訪客到會議室。

ex.en: The president arrived with a police escort.
ex.zh: 總統在警察護衛下抵達。

ex.en: Visitors must have an escort inside the factory.
ex.zh: 訪客在工廠內必須有人陪同。

ex.en: Where is the escalator?
ex.zh: 手扶梯在哪裡？

ex.en: When using the escalator, please hold the handrail and stand within the yellow line.
ex.zh: 搭乘手扶梯時，請握緊扶手，並站在黃線內。

ex.en: People who are not in a hurry stand on the right side of the escalator.
ex.zh: 不趕時間的人會站在手扶梯的右側。

ex.en: It is essentially a question of time.
ex.zh: 這基本上是時間的問題。

ex.en: The two plans are essentially the same.
ex.zh: 這兩個方案基本上是一樣的。

ex.en: Essentially, we need more staff.
ex.zh: 基本上，我們需要更多人手。

ex.en: That is the essence of the matter.
ex.zh: 這就是事情的本質。

ex.en: It's really unfortunate. You don't understand at all its essence.
ex.zh: 真可惜，你根本不懂它的精髓。

ex.en: In essence, the two plans are the same.
ex.zh: 本質上，這兩個計畫是一樣的。

ex.en: In essence, we need more time.
ex.zh: 說穿了，我們需要更多時間。

ex.en: Add a few drops of vanilla essence.
ex.zh: 加幾滴香草精。

ex.en: This soap contains lemon essence.
ex.zh: 這塊肥皂含有檸檬精油。

ex.en: By my estimation, the project will take six months.
ex.zh: 依我估計，這個專案需要六個月。

ex.en: Cost estimation is an important part of planning.
ex.zh: 成本估算是規劃中很重要的一環。

ex.en: In my estimation, he is the best candidate.
ex.zh: 依我看，他是最好的人選。

ex.en: She rose in her boss's estimation after the presentation.
ex.zh: 那次簡報後，老闆對她的評價提高了。

ex.en: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
ex.zh: 天氣熱的時候，生啤酒特別好喝。

ex.en: I like to listen to music, especially jazz.
ex.zh: 我喜歡聽音樂，尤其是爵士樂。

ex.en: The busses are especially crowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段公車特別擁擠。

ex.en: That hotel was established about 50 years ago.
ex.zh: 那家飯店大約五十年前創立。

ex.en: The school was established in 1650.
ex.zh: 這所學校創立於 1650 年。

ex.en: People established churches and schools there.
ex.zh: 人們在那裡建立了教會和學校。

ex.en: We want to establish a long-term relationship with our clients.
ex.zh: 我們希望與客戶建立長期關係。

ex.en: It's important to establish clear rules.
ex.zh: 建立明確的規則很重要。

ex.en: Police are trying to establish the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 警方正試圖查明起火原因。

ex.en: We need to establish the facts first.
ex.zh: 我們必須先查明事實。

ex.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 蔬果是均衡飲食中不可或缺的。

ex.en: In the depths of winter, a hot-water bottle is essential.
ex.zh: 在寒冬裡，熱水袋是必備的。

ex.en: It is essential that every child have the same educational opportunities.
ex.zh: 讓每個孩子都享有相同的教育機會是非常重要的。

ex.en: Pack only the essentials for the trip.
ex.zh: 旅行只帶必需品就好。

ex.en: The course covers the essentials of accounting.
ex.zh: 這門課涵蓋會計的基本要點。

ex.en: Each time he escaped, he returned to this region.
ex.zh: 他每次逃脫後都會回到這個地區。

ex.en: The cat escaped through the open window.
ex.zh: 貓從打開的窗戶溜走了。

ex.en: They went to Edinburgh to escape from the summer heat.
ex.zh: 他們去愛丁堡避暑。

ex.en: I barely escaped being hit by the truck.
ex.zh: 我差點被卡車撞到。

ex.en: He looked for every possible means of escape.
ex.zh: 他尋找一切可能的逃脫方法。

ex.en: Reading is my escape from a stressful job.
ex.zh: 閱讀是我逃離工作壓力的方式。

ex.en: She works in real estate.
ex.zh: 她從事房地產業。

ex.en: Real estate prices in Taipei are very high.
ex.zh: 台北的房價非常高。

ex.en: He left his entire estate to his daughter.
ex.zh: 他把全部遺產留給了女兒。

ex.en: The lawyer is handling her father's estate.
ex.zh: 律師正在處理她父親的遺產。

ex.en: The family owns a large estate in the countryside.
ex.zh: 那個家族在鄉下擁有一大片莊園。

ex.en: The tea estate covers 200 hectares.
ex.zh: 這座茶園佔地 200 公頃。

ex.en: It took me 2 hours to finish the essay.
ex.zh: 我花了兩個小時寫完這篇作文。

ex.en: When have we got to hand in our essays?
ex.zh: 我們什麼時候要交作文？

ex.en: All essays must be handed in on time.
ex.zh: 所有作文都必須準時繳交。

ex.en: The establishment of the new branch took two years.
ex.zh: 新分公司的設立花了兩年。

ex.en: We celebrated the tenth anniversary of the company's establishment.
ex.zh: 我們慶祝公司成立十週年。

ex.en: The restaurant is a family-run establishment.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳是家族經營的店。

ex.en: Smoking is banned in all public establishments.
ex.zh: 所有公共場所都禁止吸菸。

ex.en: He has been estranged from his brother for years.
ex.zh: 他和他哥哥已經好幾年不往來了。

ex.en: She contacted her estranged father after twenty years.
ex.zh: 她在二十年後聯絡了疏遠的父親。

ex.en: She is held in high esteem by her colleagues.
ex.zh: 她深受同事敬重。

ex.en: Praise from teachers can raise a child's self-esteem.
ex.zh: 老師的稱讚可以提升孩子的自尊心。

ex.en: The population of the country is roughly estimated at 50,000,000.
ex.zh: 這個國家的人口粗估約五千萬。

ex.en: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
ex.zh: 這幅畫估價數百萬元。

ex.en: The estimated delivery date is May 5.
ex.zh: 預計送達日期是 5 月 5 日。

ex.en: The buyer placed the deposit in escrow until the inspection was complete.
ex.zh: 買方將訂金交由第三方保管，直到檢查完成。

ex.en: The escrow account will release the funds after both parties sign.
ex.zh: 雙方簽署後，履約保管帳戶才會撥款。

ex.en: If the customer is still unhappy, escalate the issue to your manager.
ex.zh: 如果客戶還是不滿意，就把問題上報給你的主管。

ex.en: The complaint was escalated to the head office.
ex.zh: 這起客訴被上報到總公司。

ex.en: The argument quickly escalated into a fight.
ex.zh: 爭吵很快演變成打架。

ex.en: Both sides want to stop the conflict from escalating.
ex.zh: 雙方都希望阻止衝突擴大。

ex.en: The population of the country is roughly estimated at 50,000,000.
ex.zh: 這個國家的人口粗略估計是五千萬左右。

ex.en: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?
ex.zh: 你估計做那件事需要花費你多少時間呢？

ex.en: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
ex.zh: 這幅畫被估價數百萬元。

ex.en: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
ex.zh: 我想這工作粗略估計得花上兩個星期的時間。

ex.en: The builder gave us an estimate for the repairs.
ex.zh: 包商給了我們一份維修估價。
